_comment: OrigamDataTableRow component tokens — issue #503 (Paquet 1, cause C). The component's own CSS class (.origam-data-table-row) is a standalone compound block, NOT a BEM child of data-table (contrast with data-table.json's existing 'row' key, nested under 'data-table', which emits the mismatched --origam-data-table__row---* — never read by this component). Values copied verbatim from OrigamDataTableRow.vue's SCSS fallbacks, all of which reference live, currently-emitted modern semantic vars. NOTE: an orphan fallback --origam-data-table-row--mobile__column (line 335, no property suffix, itself a dead sub-fallback of --mobile__column-min-height) is intentionally left untokenised — flagged separately, see delivery report; defining --mobile__column-min-height below makes it unreachable in practice.

transition-easing.$description: Literal fallback cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) matches motion.easing.standard exactly.

column-min-height.$description: No space.* primitive matches 52px. The component's own CSS var segment is '__column-min-height' with no further property suffix (--origam-data-table-row--mobile__column-min-height) — modelled here as a $child leaf carrying the value directly, matching the exact grammar mechanism (see token-name.mjs).
